name: Equip
description: Make an NPC equip armor, clothing, ammunition, or a weapon they actually own.

source.description: The NPC who should equip the item.

item_name.description: The item to equip. Use 'best armor' for generic armor or clothing and 'best weapon' for a generic weapon.

prompt: Only begin with '{key}: <item_name> |' when the player's current request explicitly asks to equip, wear, draw, or ready something. Put the exact requested inventory name before '|'; use 'best armor' for generic armor/clothing and 'best weapon' for a generic weapon. Continue dialogue after '|', but do not claim success before Skyrim returns the result. Equip uses real inventory; use Inventory for transfers. The action result and refreshed equipment override stale context.
